assessment.reason: Moreau's recent usage clears the line in most games, and +148 is the best of six quotes at the same 1.5 line. No material blocker is identified, though the case is thin.
assessment.model_case: He caught two passes in five of six games, but on only about two to three targets. The 1.96 projection leans on a catch rate likely to regress, and the strong Giants pass defense trims the mean. The calibrated output is identical across all three candidates, so it may be coarse rather than player-specific.
assessment.price_case: Main line 1.5 at +148, break-even near two-in-five. Five other books sit between +120 and +130 at the same line, and their de-vigged over is roughly at break-even. The value comes mostly from the price outlier, which may be corrected.

assessment.price_case: All five books post 1.5 as the central line. At +107 the over needs to win slightly less than half the time, versus -114/-115 at most books and +105 at Bovada. qualitative_review.countercase: Three games is a thin base, and the target rate may be overstated. A smaller backfield share or a run-heavy lead script could leave him at one catch. assessment.reason: The over matches the lean at other books, and even money is the cheapest over available. However, the projection leans on a career baseline, while recent attempts were 29, 37 and 30.
assessment.model_case: Recent attempts average about 32, but two of three games fell below 30.5. The projection of about 33.1 comes mostly from blending in a career mean near 33.4 over 70 games, largely in another offense. The defense adjustment adds only about 0.4. Most of the work is done by transferring that career baseline to Minnesota.
assessment.price_case: The main line is 30.5 at even money, which requires a coin-flip hit rate. Other books charge -115 to -125 at 30.5, and BetMGM charges -135 at 29.5, so this is the best over price. The median-centered stress is only a break-even hypothetical. Any value depends on the model mean holding.
assessment.context_case: Cited reporting says several Vikings starters returned to practice. A returning running back could tilt the offense toward the run, while a returning tackle and receivers could help sustain drives. Game-day statuses are not supplied.

qualitative_review.countercase: If Minnesota leads at home or leans on a returning Mason, Murray could finish near his recent 29-30 attempt games. He has only three games in this offense, and his career attempt rate may not reflect its pace. The market's 30.5 line suggests books see a lower central outcome than the model does.
